We are pleased to present this excellent 3-bedroom townhouse, ideally located in a very central area of Albufeira, benefiting from excellent south-facing sun exposure. This property is perfect for those seeking comfort, convenience, and close proximity to all amenities.

The house enjoys a prime location, within walking distance of supermarkets, restaurants, cafés, shops, schools, services, and public transport, allowing for a comfortable and practical lifestyle without the need for long journeys.

The property comprises three bedrooms, three bathrooms, a kitchen, a spacious open-plan living and dining area, and a pleasant private courtyard, ideal for outdoor leisure and relaxation. Outside, there is also a BBQ area, perfect for entertaining family and friends, as well as private parking space for one car.

This is an excellent opportunity whether you are looking for a permanent residence, a holiday home, or an investment property, in one of the most sought-after areas of Albufeira.
